dict.string: Butterfly opens websites in new browser windows so it can place them side by side.
Butterfly connects your Bluetooth devices by voice and shows their battery in the notch.
Butterfly adds events and reads your agenda when you ask by voice.
macOS only shares the Wi-Fi network name with apps that have Location access. Butterfly uses it to show which network you joined.
